author: ojiudezue
title: v5.107.0 shipped: Perimeter false-positive gates: per-camera Frigate zone sensors, door-camera unknown+corroborated alerts, WhatsApp delivery truth
summary: Perimeter false-positive gates: per-camera Frigate zone sensors, door-camera unknown+corroborated alerts, WhatsApp delivery truth
why: Perimeter alerts averaged about 56 a day, much of it street walkers and empty frames. Frigate zones alone could not help because URA triggered on camera-level occupancy sensors that zones do not gate. This release consumes per-camera property-zone sensors, adds demote-only gates (zone agreement, single-source, VLM) that ship off, adds door-camera alerts that page only for unknown and corroborated people, and makes failed WhatsApp sends visible so the digest falls back to iMessage.
implications: Shipped PERIMETER-FP-STREET-NOISE-1 at v5.107.0; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.107.0.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: Done when, 7 days after the zone-sensor config is applied, URA perimeter pushes per camera on utilities_ptz, g5_bullet and rear_ptz drop against the 30-day audit baseline with a 10-snapshot spot check showing real visitors still alert; reopen if a real visitor is missed or pushes do not drop.

refs.release_notes: See docs/readmes/README_v5.107.0.md. New gates ship off except zone-sensor consumption (config) and door-camera policy; all-day burst demote stays night-only pending a daytime re-sample.
